question: Does the H-015 false-breakout excursion-order relationship survive explicit removal and control of entry/exit extremum boundaries?
mechanism: A genuine deterioration sequence should remain when MFE-at-entry and MAE-at-exit mechanics are controlled and when paths exhibiting those two directional boundary patterns are excluded.
prediction: MFE-before-MAE ordering remains positively associated with false breakouts in the boundary-clean sample and after full-sample MFE-at-entry/MAE-at-exit controls.
interpretation_boundary: Even boundary-clean ordering uses the completed frozen path and cannot establish a causal or actionable exit state.

sample.strict_interior: require both extrema strictly after entry and strictly before exit
sample.missingness: fail closed; no imputation, post-exit extension, coordinate substitution, or replay

primary_predictor: negative normalized excursion order, so positive means MFE occurs before MAE

required_tests.full_boundary_control: partial rank in all 399 cycles adding MFE-at-entry and MAE-at-exit to the H-015 controls
required_tests.boundary_clean_raw: raw/within-year/LOYO association in the fixed 265-cycle boundary-clean sample
required_tests.boundary_clean_controlled: H-015 magnitude/duration/pre-entry/year/exit partial rank in the boundary-clean sample
required_tests.strict_interior_neighbor: raw association in the fixed 179-cycle strict-interior sample

gates.boundary_clean_raw: rho >= 0.15, positive within-year rank rho, and >=7/8 positive LOYO
gates.neighbors: all three fixed neighbors have positive rho and >=6/8 positive LOYO
gates.falsification: boundary-clean ex-global-Bottom-4 P&L and holding>=5 rhos each >=0.05; >=80% positive leave-one-security and leave-one-industry omissions; >=2/3 positive baseline blocks

decision.REFINE: full boundary control and boundary-clean raw pass but at least one remaining gate fails
decision.PIVOT: boundary-clean raw passes but full boundary control fails

falsification: exact outcome-blind boundary counts fixed before the first outcome join
MFE, adverse-excursion magnitude, duration, pre-entry state, year, and exit controls
within-year ranks and eight LOYO omissions
zero post-exit rows, replays, counterfactual paths, or strategy rules
forbidden: calling completed-path boundary-clean order an actionable state
testing any entry, hold, exit, stop, ranking, sizing, or production change
changing boundary exclusions, controls, sample, neighbors, or gates after results
adding boundary definitions to rescue a failed primary
breadth historical redesign or invalid Phase 7/8/9 use
